name: depth_anything_v2_small
runtime: torch-CPU (the batch image's torch 2.4.1) + worker/depth_anything (official network code, Apache-2.0)
notes: Wave 4 track 4A (INTERFACES_W4.md §2): the depth.small sidecar, keyframes only (8 fps by default, 518-px long side).
